messages:
Marta: uploaded compact heatmap mock with p95 ribbon + tiny histogram. quick callout: what should the sampling control be labeled? 'Sampling' / 'Sample rate' / 'Downsample'?
Alex: 'Sample rate' — more explicit. show percent inline.
Jun: agree. also suggest 'Adaptive' instead of 'Auto' and a tooltip explaining behavior.
Aria (a11y): a11y nit: slider must announce value changes (aria-live) and tooltip must be keyboard-focusable. spinner needs role="status".
Sam: scrubber snaps to bucket centers now; request elastic snapping => bucket snap when zoomed out, event snap when zoomed in. backend can add exactTimes flag for client.
Marta: sounds good. acceptance: 1) label 'Sample rate' + visible percent; 2) 'Adaptive' option with tooltip copy; 3) aria-live for value + role=status spinner; 4) elastic snapping documented + exactTimes flag; 5) update p95 legend microcopy.
Alex: adding tooltip copy to Figma.
Jun: I'll paste ARIA snippets into comments.
design-bot: Reminder: design review in 20m. Figma -> https://figma.com/file/abc123/heatmap-compact
Marta: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
